name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on the 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The flagship project received approval under Argentina's RIGI investment regime in March 2026, with a construction decision expected in the second half of 2026. The company is in the development stage with a measured and indicated resource of 102 Mt grading 65 g/t silver and 0.62 g/t gold.
